title: Spanish Subtitles For This Clip
tests: Tests faithful Spanish subtitle translation and timing while retaining the source English audio and footage.

faults.what: All visible subtitles are in English rather than the requested Spanish: “Hi everyone.”, “Today I want to show you three easy”, and “ways to make your mornings less stressful.”
White subtitle text loses contrast where it overlaps her light-colored shirt.

judge.summary: The clip preserves the kitchen footage and English speech, but adds English captions instead of the requested Spanish subtitles.

must_haves.item: The output retains the complete original 10-second kitchen-table footage.
must_haves.why: The output lasts 10.1 seconds and the sampled frames show the same woman, kitchen, and framing with changing gestures.

must_haves.item: Visible Spanish subtitles convey the greeting, 'today,' three easy ways, and making mornings less stressful.
must_haves.why: These meanings appear in English captions, not Spanish subtitles.

must_haves.item: The translation is natural Spanish and does not add advice that she never gives.
must_haves.why: There is no visible Spanish translation; the captions reproduce the English speech without adding advice.

must_haves.item: Spanish subtitle chunks follow the corresponding English speech and remain legible within the frame.
must_haves.why: No Spanish chunks are present. The English captions fit within the frame, though contrast is weaker over her shirt.

must_haves.item: The original English speech remains audible, with no Spanish dub.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription reports the original English sentence and no Spanish speech.
